notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content: Added Infinite mode for Base Defense mission, available after completing wave 4.

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
New Content:
Mission 3
2 new guns
New Soldier type
New Turret type
4 new meta upgrades

various bug fixes

Gore is now unlimited

notes.title: 0.1.5 patch notes
notes.content:
New stuff:
Added an achievements menu
Added an input mapping menu

balancing:
Soldier and turret kills now count towards your kills/gun xp.  Upgrades should come faster for guns with a slower start, like the railgun, however higher ranks will require more kills per upgrade to compensate.

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
New stuff:
[list]
[*] Updated some upgrade descriptions to include numerical values (e.g. critical chance/multiplier % values).
[*] Added stats to the pause menu.
[*] Added artwork modifications for each level for turrets.
[*] Added Rocket turrets!
[/list]

Bugs and balancing:
[list]
[*] Fixed critical multiplier bug.
[*] lowered range growth for soldier and turret levels.
[*] Fixed an issue with the upgrade selection menu sounds not being effected by volume controls.
[*] Modified the way defensive satellite explosions damage enemies to hopefully prevent a possible crash.
[/list]

notes.title: Prelaunch update 0.1.3
notes.content: Added two more guns to the game, Dual Pistols and the Sub Machine Gun, and a new set of upgrades.
